_comment: Folio legal docs manifest. Source of truth for the latest ToS / Privacy version: a GitHub Action syncs this into Supabase tos_versions (which the app reads), and it is also bundled into the app as an offline fallback. Bump version + summary when ToS / Privacy changes.

terms.summary_zh: Folio 新增了「支持方案」訂閱，因此補上完整的付費條款：訂閱為月繳、自動續訂，最晚須於當期結束的 24 小時前到 App Store 或 Google Play 取消，逾時商店仍會扣下一期；升級立即生效並按比例折抵，降級於當期結束時生效。取消訂閱後，您建立的虛擬書房全部保留，可以瀏覽、分享、改名與刪除，並可自行挑選方案額度內的書房繼續佈置，已套用的書背樣式保留但無法再修改。退款依 Apple 與 Google 各自的政策辦理。請特別注意：刪除 Folio 帳號不會自動取消訂閱，請先到商店取消。另外，條款日後如有輕微文字修正（例如錯字或排版），將更新版本號並記錄於變更紀錄後生效，不再另行打擾您。
terms.summary_en: Folio now offers a "support plan" subscription, so we have added the full paid-feature terms: the plan is billed monthly and renews automatically, and you must cancel in the App Store or Google Play at least 24 hours before the current period ends, otherwise the store will charge you for the next period; upgrades take effect immediately with the remaining days prorated, and downgrades take effect at the end of the current period. After you cancel, every study room you created is kept and remains viewable, shareable, renamable, and deletable, and you may choose which rooms within your plan's allowance stay decoratable; book-spine styles you already applied are kept but can no longer be edited. Refunds follow Apple's and Google's own policies. Please note: deleting your Folio account does not cancel your subscription, so cancel it in the store first. Finally, minor wording fixes to these terms in future (typos or formatting, for example) will take effect once the version number is updated and the change is logged, without interrupting you again.

privacy.summary_zh: 因應「支持方案」訂閱上線，本次補上相關的資料處理揭露。新增蒐集「購買與訂閱狀態」，包括方案檔位、購買與續訂時間、到期時間，以及商店的交易與收據識別資訊；付款全部由 Apple 或 Google 處理，Folio 不會收集您的信用卡號。新增第三方服務 RevenueCat, Inc.（美國）協助驗證與同步您的訂閱狀態，它只會收到您的帳號識別碼、購買的產品與時間、商店收據資訊，不會收到您的姓名、Email、信用卡號或任何 App 內的內容。訂閱期間，您的支持者勳章可能顯示給其他用戶，訂閱結束後即不再顯示。此外本次一併補齊資料保留期間的說明：帳戶連續 24 個月未登入將自動刪除；使用分析的原始紀錄於帳戶存續期間保留、隨帳戶刪除一併清除；不含任何識別碼的每日彙總統計永久保留；付費紀錄作為財務憑證保留；漂流瓶封存區的信件內文於 2 年後自動清除。最後提醒：刪除 Folio 帳號不會自動取消訂閱，請先到商店取消。
privacy.summary_en: Following the launch of our "support plan" subscription, this update adds the related data-processing disclosures. We now collect "purchase and subscription status", including plan tier, purchase and renewal times, expiry time, and the store's transaction and receipt identifiers; payment is handled entirely by Apple or Google, and Folio never collects your card number. We have added a third-party service, RevenueCat, Inc. (United States), to validate and sync your subscription status; it receives only your account identifier, the product you purchased and when, and store receipt information, and never your name, email, card number, or any in-app content. While your subscription is active, your supporter badge may be shown to other users; it is no longer shown once the subscription ends. This update also completes our retention disclosures: accounts with no sign-in for 24 consecutive months are deleted automatically; raw usage-analytics records are kept for the lifetime of your account and deleted along with it; daily aggregate statistics containing no identifiers are kept indefinitely; payment records are kept as financial records; and letter contents in the drift-bottle archive are cleared automatically after 2 years. One reminder: deleting your Folio account does not cancel your subscription, so please cancel it in the store first.
